description: Live band-IMU control of the SO-ARM101 (neural_reflex.imu_teleop). Angles are your forearm's rotation from the calibrated neutral pose (forearm level, pointing forward, palm down). Tilt -> gripper height (shoulder, elbow and wrist flex move together through inverse kinematics at a fixed reach), swing -> base rotation, roll -> wrist roll. Flip a *_sign if a joint moves the wrong way in the dry run.
